notes: Undid a line-timing change that pulled each lyric line forward onto a later, louder beat and then packed the lines together. On fast, beat-driven songs that made the sheet run ahead of the singing.
For a song with no timed lyrics file, each line is placed where the voices are again, instead of several seconds early and hurrying.
The sheet still opens on the playing line, re-timing still keeps your place, and nothing else about playback changed.
Your songs, playlists and saved lyrics stay on your device — nothing in your library is removed by this release.
